name: Brutal Armor

meta.next: Brutal Hauberk (quest), Orm Stonehoof and the Brutal Helm, Ula'elek and the Brutal Gauntlets, Velora Nitely and the Brutal Legguards

summary: A warrior in the northern Barrens faces Thun'grim Firegaze's test. The near-blind smith sends seasoned Horde warriors across distant lands for rare ingredients and smelting agents. Fulfilling his scroll begins the forging of a full set of brutal battle gear.

sections.title: A Master's Calling
sections.body: In the northern Barrens, Thun'grim Firegaze listens for news of war. The veteran orc smith's eyesight is failing, but his skill at the forge remains unmatched. Rumors reach him of a warrior whose strength and valor exceed those of ordinary soldiers. Thun'grim sets out to craft mail that can withstand the fiercest battles across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

sections.title: A Cross-Continental Search
sections.body: Thun'grim's armor calls for more than common ore. By firelight, his failing eyes guide him as he writes a precise scroll for the core chestpiece. Its ingredients include refined iron, smoky iron ingots carried by burrowing kobolds, powdered azurite worked by miners across the sea, and a volatile vial of phlogiston. Only a warrior ready to face trials across distant lands can bring the required materials together.

sections.title: The First Strike of the Hammer
sections.body: Thun'grim's rare materials begin a much larger undertaking. When they arrive, he fires his furnace and forges the Brutal Hauberk. The old smith sees that he cannot complete such an ambitious armory alone. The full set calls for expert craftsmen of the other Horde races: a Tauren helm-shaper, a Troll gauntlet-maker, and an Undead greave-smith, each found across the continents.

faq.answer: Thun'grim Firegaze is a veteran orc blacksmith who lives on a hill overlooking the northern Barrens. Though his eyesight is failing, his instincts at the anvil remain sharp, and he crafts powerful custom battle mail for Horde warriors renowned for valor.

Brutal Armor is a set of battle-forged mail for seasoned Horde warriors. Horde smiths bring their skills together to make it, and each piece calls for dangerous journeys to find rare alchemical reagents, purified ores, and ancient techniques.

faq.q: Why does Thun'grim need such unusual ingredients?
faq.answer: Thun'grim needs unusual ingredients because standard iron is too brittle to endure the heavy blows faced by a frontline champion. He uses powdered azurite, smoky iron ingots, and volatile phlogiston as flux and tempering agents to give the metal greater resilience and strength.

faq.q: Does Thun'grim forge the entire set himself?
aliases: does thungrim make all of it
who makes the brutal armor pieces
faq.answer: No. Thun'grim forges the central hauberk, while fellow Horde smiths craft the matching helm, gauntlets, and legguards. They include Orm Stonehoof, Ula'elek, and Velora Nitely.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain lead next?
faq.answer: The trial leads to the forging of the Brutal Hauberk and opens the way to consult smiths in Thunder Bluff, Sen'jin Village, and the Undercity for the rest of the brutal battle mail.

faq.q: Why does a warrior have to travel so far for these materials?
faq.answer: The journey tests a warrior's martial tenacity and resourcefulness. To prove worthy of master-forged armor, a warrior must cross enemy territory, enter hazardous mines, and gather components beyond ordinary reach.

angles.text: As a Horde warrior, you prove your valor and endurance across multiple continents to earn custom-forged battle armor.
As a member of the Horde, you see Orc, Tauren, Troll, and Forsaken smiths bring their distinct craft traditions together in one battle set.
As a blacksmith, you can see how Thun'grim's scroll blends smoky iron, powdered azurite, and phlogiston to refine standard iron smelting.
